Revision Description
Update Status, Milestones, and Operator Action Sections.

Applicability
All 777 models equipped with Airplane Information Management System 2 (AIMS-2) Platform.

Description
The AIMS-2 Block Point (BP) V18 Software update includes the following changes.
Change 1: Provisions for Global Aeronautical Distress and Safety System (GADSS) Autonomous Distress Tracking (ADT)
Interface
GADSS ATD is a new system required by ICAO, EASA, and a number of regulators
GADSS/ATD interfaces with AIMS (Displays/CMCF)
Mandate for aircraft produced after Jan 1, 2023
Please refer to 777-FTD-23-20001 for more information
Change 2: Digital Flight Data Acquisition Function (DFDAF) / Displays Change to record additional FDR parameters
European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) Mandate requiring additional First Officer (FO) Display parameters to be
recorded by the Flight Data Recorder (FDR)
Mandate for aircraft produced after Jan 1, 2023
Change 3: B777 Routing Airborne Timer (RAT) 1: Very High Frequency (VHF) to Satellite Communication (SATCOM) System
Routing Timer
Expedite the discovery of unavailable VHF Media
Improve Performance-Based Communication and Surveillance (PBCS) compliance
Change 4: B777 SAT7 Timer: SATCOM Retransmission
Reduces retransmission time of SATCOM messages to increase the likelihood of achieving Required System Performance
(RSP) requirements
Improve Performance-Based Communication and Surveillance (PBCS) functionality

Status
The AIMS-2 BP V18 Software release schedule has been delayed due to new additional Network Cyber Security compliance
requirements that need to be reviewed as part of the V18 Software update. The Network Cyber Security compliance review
requires FAA approval prior to EASA review/approval. The anticipated project schedule for AIMS-2 BP V18 Production Completion
has been split into FAA Airplanes compliance and EASA Airplanes compliance.
The Service Bulletin release will follow Production Incorporation and be aligned to the EASA Airplanes compliance dates
accordingly. Boeing is currently re-baselining the AIMS-2 BP V18 Software Build Content and Schedule due to late discovery of
issues with the implementation of "Change 6", ANP Fluctuation Caused by Air Data Inertial Reference Unit (ADIRU) Erroneous
Output. The delay opened up the opportunity to accelerate incorporation of two changes from BP19 content identified as "Change
9" and "Change 10" in the Description Section. The updated Schedule Target Dates are noted below in the Milestones section.

The AIMS-2 BP V18 development milestones have experienced another delay due to expanded certification deliverable
completion flow times.
Certification Flight Testing with AIMS-2 BP V18 did occur in March 2024. Boeing has released the AIMS-2 BP V18 Service Letter
777-SL-31-064. Boeing also plans to release three AIMS-2 BP V18 Service Bulletins, as described below, in order to meet the
cyber security software loading requirements for each of the three aircraft configurations below.
Service Bulletin (SB) 777-31A0352: applicable to aircraft equipped with ONS OS 9.21.
Service Bulletin (SB) 777-31A0391: applicable to aircraft not equipped with ONS2.
Service Bulletin (SB) 777-31A0392: applicable to aircraft equipped with older ONS (i.e. NFS1 and older), or prior to OS 7.0.23.
Final GADSS testing revealed a need for a change to the AIMS-2 BP software to support the GADSS function. This additional
software change has caused for a delay in the AIMS-2 BP V18 Release Schedule which has been reflected in the Milestones
Section of this FTD.
Further delays have been encountered in AIMS-2 BP V18 Certification. The certification scope has increased to perform
additional analyses for AIMS interfacing systems. Therefore, Boeing has reverted to publishing a combined V18 SB including
both FAA and EASA certification to minimize FAA review cycle. Milestones below have been adjusted accordingly.

Final Action
Implement one of the following three AIMS-2 BP V18 Service Bulletins based on the operator's applicable aircraft configuration:
Service Bulletin (SB) 777-31A0352: applicable to aircraft equipped with ONS OS 9.21.
Service Bulletin (SB) 777-31A0391: applicable to aircraft not equipped with ONS2.
Service Bulletin (SB) 777-31A0392: applicable to aircraft equipped with older ONS (i.e. NFS1 and older), or prior to OS 7.0.23.
Please note Service Bulletin 777-31A0342 (AIMS-2 BP V17C) is a prerequisite to incorporating one of the respective AIMS-2 BP
V18 Service Bulletins above.

777-FTD-31-21002
Issue Title : 777 Airplane Information Management System 2 (AIMS-2) Block Point (BP) V18 Update
Airplane Model ATA Minor Model(s)
777 3141-00 -200,-300,-200ER,-300ER,-F,-200LR,
Other Model(s) ECCN
9E991

Revision Description
Update Status, Milestones, and Operator Action Sections.
Applicability
All 777 models equipped with Airplane Information Management System 2 (AIMS-2) Platform.
Description
The AIMS-2 Block Point (BP) V18 Software update includes the following changes.
Change 1: Provisions for Global Aeronautical Distress and Safety System (GADSS) Autonomous Distress Tracking (ADT)
Interface
GADSS ATD is a new system required by ICAO, EASA, and a number of regulators
GADSS/ATD interfaces with AIMS (Displays/CMCF)
Mandate for aircraft produced after Jan 1, 2023
Please refer to 777-FTD-23-20001 for more information
Change 2: Digital Flight Data Acquisition Function (DFDAF) / Displays Change to record additional FDR parameters
European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) Mandate requiring additional First Officer (FO) Display parameters to be
recorded by the Flight Data Recorder (FDR)
Mandate for aircraft produced after Jan 1, 2023
Change 3: B777 Routing Airborne Timer (RAT) 1: Very High Frequency (VHF) to Satellite Communication (SATCOM) System
Routing Timer
Expedite the discovery of unavailable VHF Media
Improve Performance-Based Communication and Surveillance (PBCS) compliance
Change 4: B777 SAT7 Timer: SATCOM Retransmission
Reduces retransmission time of SATCOM messages to increase the likelihood of achieving Required System Performance
(RSP) requirements
Improve Performance-Based Communication and Surveillance (PBCS) functionality

Change 5: B777 Provider Abort (PA)
Performance improvements implemented to address Operationally identified system performance (777 currently not
performing up to EUROCONTROL specifications)
Related to Aeronautical Telecommunications Network (ATN) mandated as of Feb 5, 2020 to fly in Europe above FL285
Please refer to 777-FTD-31-21001 for more information
Change 6: Actual Navigation Performance (ANP) Fluctuation Caused by Air Data Inertial Reference Unit (ADIRU) Erroneous
Output
Software update includes a new Caution Level Engine Indicating and Crew Alerting System (EICAS) message "ADIRU/GPS
DISAGREE" for Approach phase of flight only
Please refer to 777-FTD-34-21004 for more information. (Safety)
Change 7: ATC Logon page "No SEND prompt" resolution
Software update to allow the SEND prompt on the ATC LOGON/STATUS page to be available
Please refer to 777-FTD-23-16002 for more information.
Change 8: Incorrect Active Route and Lateral Navigation (LNAV) Guidance after Direct-To with Abeam Point Operation
Software update to allow the active route to display correctly after performing a direct-to with abeam points operation
Please refer to 777-FTD-34-21007 for more information.
Change 9: CHKL INCOMPLETE NORM after pressing TOGA
Update logic to prevent the display of the CHKL INCOMPLETE NORM message when it is inappropriate (i.e. after pressing
TOGA as part of a Missed Approach Procedure Activation).
777-SRP-31-0072 created for tracking and resolution.
Please refer to 777-FTD-31-18002 for more information
Change 10: CHKL NON-NORMAL Message
Update logic to prevent the display of the CHKL NON-NORMAL message when it is inappropriate
Please refer to Flight Operations Technical Bulletin 777-23-61 R1 for more information
A limited number of additional In-Service fixes will be included.
Boeing notes that there will be a GBST update required as part of the AIMS-2 BP V18 software update. See Operator Action
section below for additional details.
Status
The AIMS-2 BP V18 Software release schedule has been delayed due to new additional Network Cyber Security compliance
requirements that need to be reviewed as part of the V18 Software update. The Network Cyber Security compliance review
requires FAA approval prior to EASA review/approval. The anticipated project schedule for AIMS-2 BP V18 Production Completion
has been split into FAA Airplanes compliance and EASA Airplanes compliance.
The Service Bulletin release will follow Production Incorporation and be aligned to the EASA Airplanes compliance dates
accordingly. Boeing is currently re-baselining the AIMS-2 BP V18 Software Build Content and Schedule due to late discovery of
issues with the implementation of "Change 6", ANP Fluctuation Caused by Air Data Inertial Reference Unit (ADIRU) Erroneous
Output. The delay opened up the opportunity to accelerate incorporation of two changes from BP19 content identified as "Change
9" and "Change 10" in the Description Section. The updated Schedule Target Dates are noted below in the Milestones section.

Interface
GADSS ATD is a new system required by ICAO, EASA, and a number of regulators
GADSS/ATD interfaces with AIMS (Displays/CMCF)
Mandate for aircraft produced after Jan 1, 2023
Please refer to 777-FTD-23-20001 for more information
Change 2: Digital Flight Data Acquisition Function (DFDAF) / Displays Change to record additional FDR parameters
European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) Mandate requiring additional First Officer (FO) Display parameters to be
recorded by the Flight Data Recorder (FDR)
Mandate for aircraft produced after Jan 1, 2023
Change 3: B777 Routing Airborne Timer (RAT) 1: Very High Frequency (VHF) to Satellite Communication (SATCOM) System
Routing Timer
Expedite the discovery of unavailable VHF Media
Improve Performance-Based Communication and Surveillance (PBCS) compliance
Change 4: B777 SAT7 Timer: SATCOM Retransmission
Reduces retransmission time of SATCOM messages to increase the likelihood of achieving Required System Performance
(RSP) requirements
Improve Performance-Based Communication and Surveillance (PBCS) functionality
